_comment: rust-v8 vs node, spec parity. At most 2 allowed differences; both share ONE root cause (see README 'Env vars'). The third test with the same cause (DX-05 probe, whose env assertion fails first) is deliberately NOT allowed so its log-line assertions stay visible: it is reported FAIL.

allowed.match: deployment env vars (convex env set) are visible in both runtimes
allowed.reason: Inherent to the default Convex runtime: process.env is a Proxy with only a `get` trap (udf-runtime 00_misc.ts), so Object.entries(process.env) is empty and the host cannot populate WASI environ_get; std::env::var in the guest sees nothing. Needs an explicit name list in the host.

allowed.match: updated var is seen by the next call
allowed.reason: Same root cause as above (guest cannot enumerate deployment env vars through process.env in the default runtime).
